title: Future continuous and future perfect: review
titleEs: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto: repaso
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: Don't phone at seven. We ___ dinner.
items.explanationEs: A las siete estaremos cenando: will be + -ing.

items.prompt: By the time you wake up, I ___.
items.explanationEs: Antes de que te despiertes ya me habré ido: will have + participio (left).

items.statement: In July, I will have been living here for five years.
items.explanationEs: Cuánto tiempo llevaré en julio: will have been + -ing con for.

items.statement: I will have finished the report for Monday.
items.explanationEs: Para (antes de) una fecha es by: by Monday.

answers: What will you be doing at ten?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: what + will + sujeto + be + verbo con -ing.

items.text: By 2030, they ___ (to build) the new airport.
items.explanationEs: Terminado antes de 2030: will have + participio de build (built).

items.source: She will be waiting for us.
answers: Will she be waiting for us?

items.sentence: This time tomorrow we will be fly to Paris.
items.explanationEs: Después de will be, el verbo con -ing: will be flying.
